task.question: What was the sentence given to former president Yoon Suk Yeol in South Korea in February 2026?
task.evidence: 19 February – Former president Yoon Suk Yeol is convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment for insurrection relating to the 2024 South Korean martial law crisis.

answer: Life imprisonment for Yoon Suk Yeol.

Former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol was sentenced to life imprisonment on February 19, 2026. The sentence was handed down by the Seoul Central District Court due to his involvement in orchestrating an insurrection related to his failed declaration of martial law in December 2024. 

FINAL: Life imprisonment for Yoon Suk Yeol.
